subject.title: fix(ui): chat background-tasks rail crushes narrow panes and hides below 1120px

question: Should this protected PR be conflict-resolved and landed with both current-main chat changes and its proven pane-responsive tasks-rail behavior preserved?
rationale: The patch appears correct and product direction is already established by the sibling layout, but the dirty merge state requires maintainer control of the final resolved head.

options.title: Resolve and validate
options.body: Carry both change sets forward, rerun focused responsive tests, and confirm the same visual states on the exact resolved head.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing only if conflict resolution reveals that current-main layout direction invalidates the established workspace-first side-slot policy.

recommendation.title: Resolve and validate
recommendation.body: Carry both change sets forward, rerun focused responsive tests, and confirm the same visual states on the exact resolved head.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature and sibling responsive-layout history make this person the strongest available decision owner.
